newsitem.title: USA: Albright said considering around-the-world trip.
newsitem.headline: Albright said considering around-the-world trip.

text.p: U.S. Secretary of State-designate Madeleine Albright is considering making an around-the-world trip as her first overseas venture, administration officials said on Tuesday.
They told Reuters that dates discussed for the trip are Feb. 12 through 22.
The U.S. officials said the trip was expected to begin in London and possibly end in Beijing or Tokyo. One official said discussions centred on visiting key world capitals.

Albright's appointment to replace Warren Christopher has been announced by President Bill Clinton, but she has not yet been confirmed by the Senate. The Senate is expected to act next week after Clinton is inaugurated for a second term and key senators have assured her of confirmation.
At her confirmation hearings last week before the Senate Foreign Relations Committee, Albright said she would make an early trip to Asia that would include South Korea and Japan.
